description: A consortium of six alternative-asset managers — Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR — anchored by NVIDIA, building independent financial platforms to channel a targeted $500B+ of third-party institutional capital into AI infrastructure ('AI factories'). Announced by Jensen Huang, Aug 2026; a shift from one-off datacenter projects to repeatable, institutionally-financed AI-infra.
